items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Sun Ra always said it began billions of years ago.

ctx.x: Oh, okay. I see what you’re saying.
So maybe jazz didn’t begin in 1900. Maybe it began – Sun Ra always said it began billions of years ago. Of course nobody believed him, but . . .
Yeah, well they didn’t believe a lot of things he said.
